Flow.description: On lead conversion, copies Lead Source to Opportunity Origination when it is ConstructConnect, Spartan Systems or Influencer. A standard field cannot be mapped to a custom field in Map Lead Fields, so a flow does it.
Flow.label: SPX Lead Convert Origination

start.filterFormula: AND(NOT({!$Permission.SPX_Bypass_Automation}), {!$Record.IsConverted}, ISCHANGED({!$Record.IsConverted}), NOT(ISBLANK({!$Record.ConvertedOpportunityId})), OR(TEXT({!$Record.LeadSource}) = "ConstructConnect", TEXT({!$Record.LeadSource}) = "Influencer", TEXT({!$Record.LeadSource}) = "Rep Firm", TEXT({!$Record.LeadSource}) = "Rep Entered", TEXT({!$Record.LeadSource}) = "Other"))
